example.zh: 法国是一个共和国，没有国王。
example.en: France is a republic; it has no king.

example.zh: 这个房间阳光充足，非常适合养花。
example.en: This room gets plenty of sunlight and is perfect for growing flowers.

人工.indonesian: buatan; buatan manusia; tenaga manusia; kerja manual

example.zh: 这片湖是人工挖出来的，并不是天然的。
example.en: This lake was dug by people; it is not natural.

群众.gloss: the masses; the public; the people

example.zh: 围观的群众越来越多，交通都堵住了。
example.en: More and more onlookers gathered, and the traffic came to a standstill.

example.zh: 工人们正在用水泥修补地面。
example.en: The workers are patching the ground with cement.

散发.gloss: to give off; to emit; to distribute; to hand out

example.zh: 厨房里散发出一股诱人的香味。
example.en: A tempting smell was coming from the kitchen.

口气.gloss: tone (of voice); manner of speaking; implied meaning
口气.indonesian: nada bicara; cara bicara; maksud tersirat

example.zh: 听他的口气，好像对结果不太满意。
example.en: Judging by his tone, he doesn't seem very happy with the result.

example.zh: 她在一家大公司负责公关工作。
example.en: She is in charge of public relations at a big company.

example.zh: 旅游业已经成为当地的支柱产业。
example.en: Tourism has become a pillar industry of the area.

example.zh: 科学家在山上采集了很多植物标本。
example.en: The scientists collected many plant specimens on the mountain.

琢磨.gloss: to ponder; to mull over; to figure out

example.zh: 这个问题我琢磨了半天也没想明白。
example.en: I turned this problem over for ages and still couldn't figure it out.

example.zh: 她虽然穿得很简单，但气质非常好。
example.en: Although she dresses simply, she carries herself very elegantly.

example.zh: 这首歌的旋律很优美，听一遍就记住了。
example.en: This song has a lovely melody; you remember it after one listen.

example.zh: 诚实是一个人最重要的品质。
example.en: Honesty is the most important quality a person can have.

example.zh: 他被任命为公司的新经理。
example.en: He was appointed the company's new manager.

example.zh: 这部电影上映后引起了很大的争议。
example.en: The film caused a lot of controversy after its release.

颠倒.gloss: to turn upside down; to reverse; to invert; confused

example.zh: 你把这两个字的顺序弄颠倒了。
example.en: You've got the order of these two characters reversed.

算数.gloss: to count; to be valid; to keep one's word

example.zh: 你放心，我说话一向算数。
example.en: Don't worry, I always keep my word.

example.zh: 这些茶叶按质量分成三个等级。
example.en: These teas are divided into three grades by quality.

example.zh: 他对自己的现状并不满意，想换个工作。
example.en: He isn't happy with his current situation and wants to change jobs.

宽容.gloss: tolerant; lenient; to tolerate; to forgive

example.zh: 对别人的小错误，我们应该宽容一些。
example.en: We should be more tolerant of other people's small mistakes.

example.zh: 这座宫殿已有六百多年的历史。
example.en: This palace is more than six hundred years old.

俘虏.gloss: prisoner of war; captive; to capture; to captivate

example.zh: 她的笑容俘虏了所有观众的心。
example.en: Her smile captured the hearts of the whole audience.

example.zh: 前面的司机一直按喇叭，吵死了。
example.en: The driver in front kept honking his horn; it was so noisy.

莫名其妙.gloss: baffling; inexplicable; for no apparent reason; puzzled
莫名其妙.indonesian: membingungkan; tidak masuk akal; tanpa alasan jelas; bingung

example.zh: 他莫名其妙地对我发了一通火。
example.en: He flew into a rage at me for no apparent reason.

example.zh: 运动场四周挂满了各国的旗帜。
example.en: The flags of many countries hung all around the stadium.

example.zh: 申请的期限是本月三十号。
example.en: The deadline for applications is the 30th of this month.

example.zh: 下棋可以帮助孩子开发智力。
example.en: Playing chess can help children develop their intelligence.

探测.gloss: to probe; to detect; to survey; to explore

example.zh: 科学家用卫星探测火星表面的情况。
example.en: Scientists use satellites to survey the surface of Mars.

example.zh: 我们在这个问题上存在一些分歧。
example.en: We have some differences of opinion on this issue.

example.zh: 这款手机的用户已经超过一亿。
example.en: This phone now has more than a hundred million users.

当选.gloss: to be elected; to be chosen

example.zh: 她当选为今年的优秀教师。
example.en: She was chosen as this year's outstanding teacher.

example.zh: 今年冬天天气反常，一点儿也不冷。
example.en: The weather is unusual this winter; it isn't cold at all.

example.zh: 原先这里是一片农田，现在盖满了高楼。
example.en: This used to be farmland; now it is covered with tall buildings.

书面.gloss: written; in writing; in written form
书面.indonesian: tertulis; secara tertulis; dalam bentuk tulisan

example.zh: 请把你的意见用书面形式交给我们。
example.en: Please submit your comments to us in writing.

遥控.indonesian: kendali jarak jauh; remot; mengendalikan dari jauh

example.zh: 电视的遥控器又找不到了。
example.en: I can't find the TV remote control again.

颤抖.gloss: to tremble; to shiver; to shake

example.zh: 她冷得浑身颤抖，说不出话来。
example.en: She was so cold she was shaking all over and couldn't speak.

example.zh: 每天无事可做，他觉得内心很空虚。
example.en: With nothing to do every day, he felt empty inside.

example.zh: 这面墙是用红砖砌成的。
example.en: This wall is built of red bricks.

反感.gloss: to dislike; to be disgusted with; aversion

example.zh: 他说话太傲慢，让人很反感。
example.en: He talks so arrogantly that people find him off-putting.

example.zh: 做这种事一点儿也不光彩。
example.en: There is nothing honourable about doing something like this.

example.zh: 雪地上留下了小动物的踪迹。
example.en: Small animals left tracks in the snow.

example.zh: 她病了好几天，脸色很苍白。
example.en: She has been ill for several days and looks very pale.

排斥.gloss: to reject; to exclude; to repel

example.zh: 新来的同学并没有受到大家的排斥。
example.en: The new classmate was not shut out by the others.

example.zh: 忙碌了一整天，他终于可以休息了。
example.en: After a whole busy day, he could finally rest.

否决.gloss: to veto; to vote down; to reject

example.zh: 他的建议在会上被否决了。
example.en: His proposal was voted down at the meeting.

交代.gloss: to explain; to account for; to hand over; to brief

example.zh: 走之前，经理把工作都交代清楚了。
example.en: Before leaving, the manager clearly handed over all the work.

设想.gloss: to imagine; to envisage; idea; tentative plan

example.zh: 这只是我的一个初步设想，还需要讨论。
example.en: This is just a preliminary idea of mine; it still needs discussion.

终究.gloss: after all; in the end; eventually

example.zh: 孩子终究是孩子，不能要求太高。
example.en: Children are children after all; you can't expect too much.

example.zh: 长时间看手机会影响视力。
example.en: Looking at your phone for long periods can affect your eyesight.

延续.gloss: to continue; to go on; to last

example.zh: 这个传统已经延续了几百年。
example.en: This tradition has continued for several hundred years.

example.zh: 一个人的内在美比外表更重要。
example.en: A person's inner beauty matters more than their looks.

example.zh: 他在这次比赛中获得了一枚铜牌。
example.en: He won a bronze medal in this competition.

example.zh: 新疆种植了大量的棉花。
example.en: Large amounts of cotton are grown in Xinjiang.

example.zh: 请先寄几件样品给我们看看。
example.en: Please send us a few samples to look at first.

忍耐.gloss: to endure; to bear; to be patient; patience

example.zh: 再忍耐一下，我们马上就到家了。
example.en: Hang on a little longer; we'll be home soon.

实行.gloss: to implement; to carry out; to put into practice

example.zh: 学校从下学期开始实行新的作息时间。
example.en: The school will put a new timetable into practice next term.

岁月.gloss: years; time; the passing of time

example.zh: 岁月在他的脸上留下了痕迹。
example.en: The years have left their mark on his face.

啃.gloss: to gnaw; to nibble; to bite; to pore over (a book)

example.zh: 小狗正趴在地上啃骨头。
example.en: The puppy is lying on the ground gnawing a bone.

约束.gloss: to restrict; to bind; to constrain; restraint

example.zh: 每个人都应该用规则约束自己的行为。
example.en: Everyone should restrain their behaviour by the rules.

灭亡.gloss: to perish; to die out; to be destroyed; extinction

example.zh: 恐龙为什么会灭亡，到现在还是个谜。
example.en: Why the dinosaurs died out is still a mystery today.

example.zh: 每个人都有自己的专长。
example.en: Everyone has their own area of expertise.

部署.gloss: to deploy; to arrange; to plan; deployment

example.zh: 公司已经部署好下一阶段的工作。
example.en: The company has already planned out the next stage of work.

辩解.gloss: to justify oneself; to explain away; to defend (one's position)

example.zh: 错了就是错了，你不用再辩解了。
example.en: Wrong is wrong; there's no need to make excuses.

合成.gloss: to synthesize; to compose; to combine; synthetic

example.zh: 这张照片是用电脑合成的。
example.en: This photo was put together on a computer.

值班.gloss: to be on duty; to work a shift

example.zh: 今天晚上轮到我在医院值班。
example.en: Tonight it's my turn to be on duty at the hospital.

example.zh: 钢笔没墨水儿了，借我一支笔吧。
example.en: My fountain pen is out of ink; lend me a pen.

记载.gloss: to record; to put down in writing; record; account

example.zh: 这本书详细记载了当地的风俗习惯。
example.en: This book records the local customs in detail.

补救.gloss: to remedy; to rectify; to make up for

example.zh: 发现问题后，他立刻想办法补救。
example.en: Once he found the problem, he immediately tried to put it right.

example.zh: 这所大学有完善的教学体系。
example.en: This university has a well-developed teaching system.

example.zh: 加了一周的班，大家都显得很疲惫。
example.en: After a week of overtime, everyone looked exhausted.

生效.gloss: to take effect; to come into force

example.zh: 新的规定从下个月一号起生效。
example.en: The new regulations take effect on the first of next month.

example.zh: 这里气候温和，四季如春。
example.en: The climate here is mild; it is like spring all year round.

教养.gloss: upbringing; good manners; to bring up; to educate

example.zh: 从他说话的方式可以看出，他很有教养。
example.en: You can tell from the way he talks that he is well brought up.

埋伏.gloss: to lie in wait; to ambush; ambush

example.zh: 猫埋伏在草丛里，等着老鼠出来。
example.en: The cat lay in wait in the grass for the mouse to come out.

example.zh: 城市的用水主要由这座水库供给。
example.en: The city's water is mainly supplied by this reservoir.

疑惑.gloss: doubt; puzzlement; to feel puzzled; uncertain

example.zh: 听了他的解释，我心里还是有些疑惑。
example.en: Even after hearing his explanation, I still had some doubts.

example.zh: 这篇文章的标题很吸引人。
example.en: The title of this article is very eye-catching.

搏斗.gloss: to struggle; to fight; to wrestle

example.zh: 船员们与风浪搏斗了一整夜。
example.en: The crew battled the wind and waves all night.

抚摸.gloss: to stroke; to caress; to pet

example.zh: 她轻轻抚摸着小猫的头。
example.en: She gently stroked the kitten's head.

不顾.gloss: regardless of; in spite of; to disregard

example.zh: 他不顾家人的反对，辞职去创业了。
example.en: Despite his family's objections, he quit his job to start a business.

example.zh: 中午的阳光十分耀眼。
example.en: The midday sun is dazzling.

example.zh: 火药是中国古代四大发明之一。
example.en: Gunpowder is one of the four great inventions of ancient China.

拾.gloss: to pick up; to collect; ten (formal numeral used on cheques)
拾.indonesian: memungut; mengambil (dari tanah); sepuluh (angka resmi pada cek)

example.zh: 他在路上拾到一个钱包，交给了警察。
example.en: He picked up a wallet in the street and handed it to the police.

example.zh: 他感冒了，一直流鼻涕。
example.en: He has a cold and his nose keeps running.

迷信.gloss: superstition; to be superstitious about; to have blind faith in
迷信.indonesian: takhayul; percaya takhayul; percaya secara membabi buta

example.zh: 我们不应该盲目迷信专家的话。
example.en: We shouldn't blindly believe everything experts say.

讨好.gloss: to curry favour with; to please; to fawn on

example.zh: 他总是想办法讨好老板。
example.en: He is always trying to get on the boss's good side.

example.zh: 孩子们脸上露出灿烂的笑容。
example.en: The children's faces lit up with bright smiles.

example.zh: 清晨的公园里有很多人在锻炼。
example.en: Early in the morning many people exercise in the park.

出身.gloss: family background; origin; to come from (a family)
出身.indonesian: latar belakang keluarga; asal-usul; berasal dari

example.zh: 他出身于一个普通的农民家庭。
example.en: He comes from an ordinary farming family.

example.zh: 他的野心很大，想把公司做成行业第一。
example.en: He is very ambitious and wants to make the company number one in the industry.

瞪.gloss: to stare; to glare; to open one's eyes wide

example.zh: 妈妈瞪了他一眼，他马上不说话了。
example.en: His mother glared at him, and he immediately went quiet.

example.zh: 这个季度公司的销售额增长了百分之十。
example.en: The company's sales grew by ten percent this quarter.

example.zh: 请从这些数字中任意选一个。
example.en: Please pick any one of these numbers.

理所当然.gloss: only natural; as it should be; to be taken for granted
理所当然.indonesian: sudah sewajarnya; sudah semestinya; dianggap wajar

example.zh: 父母的照顾不是理所当然的，我们要懂得感恩。
example.en: Our parents' care is not something to take for granted; we should be grateful.

example.zh: 读书可以开阔我们的视野。
example.en: Reading can broaden our horizons.

example.zh: 他在公司担任经理职务。
example.en: He holds the position of manager at the company.

粉碎.gloss: to smash; to shatter; to crush; broken to pieces

example.zh: 杯子掉在地上，摔得粉碎。
example.en: The cup fell on the floor and smashed to pieces.

残留.gloss: to remain; to be left over; residue

example.zh: 蔬菜上可能残留着农药，要洗干净再吃。
example.en: Vegetables may have pesticide residue on them, so wash them before eating.

example.zh: 面对对方的挑衅，他始终保持冷静。
example.en: Faced with the other side's provocation, he kept his cool.

疏远.gloss: to drift apart; to become estranged; to keep at a distance; distant

example.zh: 搬家以后，我们的关系慢慢疏远了。
example.en: After the move, we gradually drifted apart.

摊.gloss: to spread out; to share (costs); stall; measure word for puddles

example.zh: 晚饭的钱我们三个人平摊吧。
example.en: Let's split the cost of dinner three ways.

动身.gloss: to set out; to leave (on a journey)

example.zh: 我们明天一早就动身去北京。
example.en: We'll set off for Beijing early tomorrow morning.

example.zh: 这家店的价格很公道。
example.en: This shop's prices are very fair.

擅自.gloss: without permission; on one's own authority; unauthorized

example.zh: 员工不能擅自离开工作岗位。
example.en: Employees may not leave their posts without permission.

example.zh: 这支球队曾经有过辉煌的历史。
example.en: This team once had a glorious history.

蔓延.gloss: to spread; to extend; to creep

example.zh: 没人打理，野草很快蔓延到了整个院子。
example.en: With no one looking after it, weeds soon spread across the whole yard.

example.zh: 这架飞机的左翼出了点小问题。
example.en: There is a minor problem with the plane's left wing.

example.zh: 记者对新闻要有敏锐的观察力。
example.en: A journalist needs a keen eye for news.

扒.gloss: to hold on to; to dig; to strip off; to push aside

example.zh: 他扒开人群，挤到了最前面。
example.en: He pushed through the crowd and squeezed to the very front.

example.zh: 人们在废墟上重建了自己的家园。
example.en: People rebuilt their homes on the ruins.

致力.gloss: to devote oneself to; to work for

example.zh: 他多年来一直致力于环境保护工作。
example.en: For many years he has devoted himself to environmental protection.

example.zh: 饼干要放在密封的盒子里才不会受潮。
example.en: Biscuits should be kept in an airtight box so they don't go soft.

轰动.gloss: to cause a sensation; to make a stir; sensational

example.zh: 这条新闻轰动了全国。
example.en: This news caused a sensation across the country.

example.zh: 她眨了眨眼睛，好像不明白我的意思。
example.en: She blinked, as if she didn't understand what I meant.

审理.gloss: to try (a case); to hear (a case)

example.zh: 这起合同纠纷将在下周开庭审理。
example.en: This contract dispute will be heard in court next week.

呼唤.gloss: to call; to call out to; to summon

example.zh: 我听见远处有人在呼唤我的名字。
example.en: I heard someone in the distance calling my name.

example.zh: 她很少戴首饰，打扮得很朴素。
example.en: She rarely wears jewellery and dresses very simply.

设立.gloss: to set up; to establish; to found

example.zh: 学校设立了奖学金，鼓励学生努力学习。
example.en: The school set up a scholarship to encourage students to study hard.

弦.gloss: string (of an instrument); bowstring; spring (of a clock)

example.zh: 吉他的一根弦断了，得换一根新的。
example.en: One of the guitar strings broke; it needs replacing.

延期.gloss: to postpone; to delay; to extend (a deadline)

example.zh: 因为下大雨，运动会延期举行。
example.en: Because of heavy rain, the sports day was postponed.

example.zh: 北极熊生活在寒冷的北极地区。
example.en: Polar bears live in the cold Arctic region.

蒸发.gloss: to evaporate; evaporation; to vanish into thin air

example.zh: 天气太热，盆里的水很快就蒸发了。
example.en: It was so hot that the water in the basin quickly evaporated.

登录.gloss: to log in; to sign in; to register

example.zh: 请先登录你的账号，再提交作业。
example.en: Please log in to your account first, then submit your homework.

竖.gloss: vertical; upright; to erect; vertical stroke

example.zh: 路边竖着一块很大的广告牌。
example.en: A huge billboard stands by the roadside.

example.zh: 买东西不能盲目跟风。
example.en: You shouldn't blindly follow trends when you shop.

冲击.gloss: to impact; to pound; impact; shock

example.zh: 网上购物对传统商店造成了很大的冲击。
example.en: Online shopping has had a big impact on traditional shops.

example.zh: 最近他频繁地出差，很少在家。
example.en: He has been travelling for work a lot lately and is rarely home.

example.zh: 面对困难，我们不要畏惧。
example.en: We should not be afraid when facing difficulties.

支配.gloss: to control; to dominate; to allocate; to arrange

example.zh: 周末的时间可以由自己自由支配。
example.en: You can spend your weekend time however you like.

example.zh: 通过考试后，你会拿到一张证书。
example.en: After passing the exam, you will receive a certificate.

example.zh: 我时常想起小时候在乡下的生活。
example.en: I often think of my childhood in the countryside.

example.zh: 站在山顶看日出，景色十分壮观。
example.en: Watching the sunrise from the summit is a spectacular sight.

example.zh: 他努力克制自己的情绪，没有发火。
example.en: He tried hard to control his emotions and didn't lose his temper.

example.zh: 原材料涨价，生产成本也提高了。
example.en: Raw materials went up in price, so production costs rose too.

思念.gloss: to miss; to long for; to think of

example.zh: 在国外留学的时候，我常常思念家人。
example.en: When I was studying abroad, I often missed my family.

example.zh: 借的书请在两周内归还。
example.en: Please return borrowed books within two weeks.

example.zh: 这一带都是新建的住宅区。
example.en: This whole area is a newly built residential district.

example.zh: 看到孩子这么懂事，妈妈感到很欣慰。
example.en: Seeing her child so sensible made the mother feel very gratified.

example.zh: 两国签订了友好合作条约。
example.en: The two countries signed a treaty of friendship and cooperation.

捧.gloss: to hold in both hands; to carry in cupped hands; to flatter; measure word for handfuls
捧.indonesian: menatang; memegang dengan kedua tangan; menyanjung; segenggam

example.zh: 她双手捧着一束鲜花走了进来。
example.en: She came in holding a bunch of flowers in both hands.

削.gloss: to peel; to pare; to cut; to reduce

example.zh: 他正在给奶奶削苹果。
example.en: He is peeling an apple for his grandma.

example.zh: 他做事一贯很认真，从来不马虎。
example.en: He has always been conscientious and is never careless.

example.zh: 他在这家公司持有百分之二十的股份。
example.en: He holds a twenty percent stake in this company.

example.zh: 这座博物馆记录了那段被侵略的历史。
example.en: This museum documents that period when the country was invaded.

example.zh: 小说里的人物形象非常丰满。
example.en: The characters in the novel are very fully drawn.

玉.indonesian: giok; batu giok; (kiasan) murni dan indah

example.zh: 这只玉镯是奶奶留给她的。
example.en: This jade bracelet was left to her by her grandmother.

更新.gloss: to update; to renew; to replace the old with the new

example.zh: 我的手机系统需要更新了。
example.en: My phone's system needs updating.

推理.gloss: to reason; to infer; reasoning; inference

example.zh: 通过严密的推理，他找到了问题的答案。
example.en: Through careful reasoning, he found the answer to the problem.

授予.gloss: to award; to confer; to grant

example.zh: 学校授予他荣誉博士学位。
example.en: The university awarded him an honorary doctorate.

example.zh: 爷爷年纪大了，走路离不开拐杖。
example.en: Grandpa is old now and can't walk without a walking stick.

example.zh: 这个理论还需要通过实验来验证。
example.en: This theory still needs to be verified by experiment.

example.zh: 鸡蛋和牛奶里含有丰富的蛋白质。
example.en: Eggs and milk are rich in protein.

庞大.indonesian: sangat besar; raksasa; luar biasa besar

example.zh: 这个项目需要一笔庞大的资金。
example.en: This project requires an enormous amount of money.

example.zh: 这些水果可以在冰箱里储存一个星期。
example.en: These fruits can be kept in the fridge for a week.

example.zh: 我的衬衫上掉了一颗纽扣儿。
example.en: A button has come off my shirt.

example.zh: 她总是紧跟时尚潮流。
example.en: She always keeps up with the latest fashion trends.

扛.gloss: to carry on one's shoulder; to shoulder (responsibility)

example.zh: 他扛着一袋大米上了五楼。
example.en: He carried a sack of rice on his shoulder up to the fifth floor.

徘徊.gloss: to pace up and down; to hesitate; to waver; to hover (around a level)

example.zh: 他在门口徘徊了很久，最后还是没有进去。
example.en: He paced outside the door for a long time and in the end didn't go in.

example.zh: 骑车下坡的时候要注意安全。
example.en: Be careful when cycling downhill.

包袱.gloss: bundle wrapped in cloth; burden; weight on one's mind

example.zh: 放下思想包袱，轻松地去考试吧。
example.en: Let go of your worries and take the exam in a relaxed frame of mind.

侧面.indonesian: sisi; samping; profil; secara tidak langsung

example.zh: 我从侧面了解了一下他的情况。
example.en: I found out about his situation indirectly.

不择手段.gloss: by fair means or foul; by any means necessary; unscrupulously
不择手段.indonesian: menghalalkan segala cara; dengan segala cara

example.zh: 他为了赚钱不择手段，最后失去了朋友。
example.en: He would do anything to make money and ended up losing his friends.

example.zh: 他伸出双臂，紧紧地抱住了妈妈。
example.en: He stretched out his arms and hugged his mother tightly.

example.zh: 啤酒倒得太快，杯子里全是泡沫。
example.en: The beer was poured too fast, and the glass was full of foam.

example.zh: 夫妻之间难免会有一些摩擦。
example.en: Some friction between husband and wife is inevitable.

捍卫.gloss: to defend; to safeguard; to uphold

example.zh: 每个人都有权利捍卫自己的合法权益。
example.en: Everyone has the right to defend their lawful rights and interests.

example.zh: 这篇文章层次清楚，很容易理解。
example.en: This essay is clearly structured and easy to understand.

example.zh: 我把要做的事情都记在手机备忘录里。
example.en: I note down everything I need to do in my phone's memo app.

example.zh: 去之前最好预先打个电话。
example.en: It's best to phone ahead before you go.

example.zh: 老师用图片辅助讲解，学生更容易理解。
example.en: The teacher uses pictures to aid the explanation, so students understand more easily.

戒备.gloss: to guard against; to be on the alert; vigilance

example.zh: 她对陌生人总是有很强的戒备心理。
example.en: She is always very wary of strangers.

example.zh: 你知道冰箱的工作原理吗？
example.en: Do you know how a refrigerator works?

劈.gloss: to split; to chop; to cleave; (of lightning) to strike

example.zh: 爷爷每天早上都在院子里劈柴。
example.en: Grandpa chops firewood in the yard every morning.

example.zh: 这篇论文结构严密，逻辑清楚。
example.en: This paper is tightly structured and logically clear.

苏醒.gloss: to wake up; to regain consciousness; to come to

example.zh: 春天到了，万物开始苏醒。
example.en: Spring has arrived and everything is coming back to life.

example.zh: 我们可以通过多种渠道了解市场信息。
example.en: We can learn about the market through many channels.

example.zh: 他在这家公司工作了将近十年。
example.en: He has worked at this company for nearly ten years.

创新.gloss: to innovate; innovation; to bring forth new ideas

example.zh: 企业只有不断创新，才能在竞争中生存。
example.en: Only by constantly innovating can a company survive the competition.

example.zh: 当前最重要的任务是提高产品质量。
example.en: The most important task at present is to improve product quality.

奔驰.gloss: to speed; to gallop; to run quickly

example.zh: 一列火车在草原上奔驰。
example.en: A train is speeding across the grassland.

塑造.gloss: to shape; to mould; to portray (a character)

example.zh: 这部电影成功地塑造了一位好老师的形象。
example.en: This film successfully portrays a good teacher.

example.zh: 医生用酒精给伤口消毒。
example.en: The doctor disinfected the wound with alcohol.

example.zh: 这项投资给公司带来了不少收益。
example.en: This investment brought the company considerable returns.

example.zh: 孩子们在海边玩得非常快活。
example.en: The children had a wonderful time playing at the beach.

况且.indonesian: lagi pula; apalagi; di samping itu

example.zh: 天已经黑了，况且又下着雨，你别走了。
example.en: It's already dark, and besides, it's raining, so don't leave.

example.zh: 这条瀑布从几十米高的山上流下来。
example.en: This waterfall pours down from a mountain dozens of metres high.

散布.gloss: to spread; to disseminate; to scatter

example.zh: 不要在网上散布没有根据的消息。
example.en: Don't spread unfounded rumours online.

捕捉.gloss: to catch; to seize; to capture (an image, opportunity)

example.zh: 摄影师捕捉到了这个美好的瞬间。
example.en: The photographer captured this beautiful moment.

偏偏.gloss: contrary to expectations; just (of all times); insistently; deliberately

example.zh: 我急着出门，偏偏找不到钥匙。
example.en: I was in a hurry to go out, and of course I couldn't find my keys.

麻痹.gloss: paralysis; numbness; to lower one's guard; careless

example.zh: 快到终点了，千万不能麻痹大意。
example.en: We're nearly at the finish, so we mustn't let our guard down.

example.zh: 这把刀很锋利，用的时候要小心。
example.en: This knife is very sharp; be careful when you use it.

example.zh: 他第一次做饭，动作显得很笨拙。
example.en: It was his first time cooking, and he looked very clumsy.

救济.gloss: to relieve; to provide relief; relief (aid)

example.zh: 政府给受灾的家庭发放了救济物资。
example.en: The government handed out relief supplies to families hit by the disaster.

example.zh: 他说话太直，得罪了不少人。
example.en: He speaks so bluntly that he has offended quite a few people.

岂有此理.gloss: outrageous; preposterous; how can this be
岂有此理.indonesian: keterlaluan; tidak masuk akal; masa begitu

example.zh: 他借钱不还，还骂人，真是岂有此理！
example.en: He won't pay back the money and swears at people too. It's outrageous!

高明.indonesian: cerdik; pandai; hebat; orang yang ahli

example.zh: 这个办法真高明，问题一下子就解决了。
example.en: What a brilliant idea; the problem was solved at once.

example.zh: 学校为毕业生举行了隆重的毕业典礼。
example.en: The school held a grand graduation ceremony for the graduates.

让步.gloss: to concede; to give in; to yield; concession

example.zh: 经过讨论，双方都做了一些让步。
example.en: After discussion, both sides made some concessions.

枝.gloss: branch; twig; measure word for long thin objects (pens, flowers)
枝.indonesian: cabang; ranting; kata satuan untuk benda panjang (pena, bunga)

example.zh: 他送了我一枝红玫瑰。
example.en: He gave me a red rose.

example.zh: 机遇只留给有准备的人。
example.en: Opportunity only comes to those who are prepared.

example.zh: 在网上诽谤别人是违法的。
example.en: Slandering people online is against the law.

example.zh: 这场洪水冲毁了很多农田。
example.en: The flood washed away a lot of farmland.

扭转.gloss: to reverse; to turn around (a situation); to twist

example.zh: 下半场他们终于扭转了局面。
example.en: In the second half they finally turned the game around.

example.zh: 考试结果完全出乎我的意料。
example.en: The exam result was completely beyond my expectations.

example.zh: 这家餐厅在当地享有很高的声誉。
example.en: This restaurant enjoys a very good reputation locally.

别扭.gloss: awkward; uncomfortable; hard to get along with; at odds
别扭.indonesian: canggung; tidak nyaman; susah diatur; tidak akur

example.zh: 第一次穿高跟鞋，走起路来很别扭。
example.en: Wearing high heels for the first time, she felt awkward walking.

example.zh: 这项新技术已经申请了专利。
example.en: A patent has already been applied for on this new technology.

拣.gloss: to choose; to pick; to select; to pick up

example.zh: 她拣了几个最红的苹果放进篮子里。
example.en: She picked out a few of the reddest apples and put them in the basket.

愈.gloss: to heal; to recover; the more ... the more

example.zh: 雨愈下愈大，我们只好在屋里等着。
example.en: The rain got heavier and heavier, so we had to wait indoors.

example.zh: 她脸上露出了喜悦的笑容。
example.en: A joyful smile appeared on her face.

区分.gloss: to distinguish; to differentiate; to tell apart

example.zh: 这对双胞胎长得太像了，很难区分。
example.en: These twins look so alike that it's hard to tell them apart.

example.zh: 这个小男孩很机灵，一教就会。
example.en: This little boy is very bright; he learns as soon as you show him.

example.zh: 这套音响的效果非常好。
example.en: This sound system sounds excellent.

example.zh: 这个盒子做得很精致，我舍不得扔。
example.en: This box is so finely made that I can't bear to throw it away.

example.zh: 他虽然身体有残疾，但从来没有放弃过梦想。
example.en: Although he has a physical disability, he has never given up on his dreams.

抢救.gloss: to rescue; to save (a life); to give emergency treatment

example.zh: 经过医生的全力抢救，病人终于脱离了危险。
example.en: After the doctors' all-out efforts, the patient was finally out of danger.

example.zh: 门把手坏了，得找人来修。
example.en: The door handle is broken; we need to get someone to fix it.

example.zh: 为了省钱，我们得减少不必要的开支。
example.en: To save money, we need to cut unnecessary expenses.

迄今为止.gloss: so far; up to now; to date

example.zh: 这是迄今为止我看过的最好的电影。
example.en: This is the best film I have seen so far.

example.zh: 公司明天要召开股东大会。
example.en: The company is holding its shareholders' meeting tomorrow.

生育.gloss: to give birth to; to bear (children); childbearing

example.zh: 现在很多年轻人推迟了生育的年龄。
example.en: Nowadays many young people are putting off having children.

消耗.gloss: to consume; to use up; consumption

example.zh: 跑步能消耗大量的热量。
example.en: Running burns a lot of calories.

example.zh: 青少年正处在身体发育的关键时期。
example.en: Teenagers are at a crucial stage of physical development.

example.zh: 他输了比赛，却很有风度地祝贺对手。
example.en: He lost the match but graciously congratulated his opponent.

辜负.gloss: to let down; to fail to live up to; to disappoint

example.zh: 我一定努力学习，不辜负父母的期望。
example.en: I will study hard and not let my parents down.

example.zh: 开了一天的会，他感到十分疲倦。
example.en: After a whole day of meetings, he felt very tired.

example.zh: 警察很快就抓住了那个歹徒。
example.en: The police soon caught the criminal.

example.zh: 这只小鹿身上有白色的斑点。
example.en: This fawn has white spots on its body.

分解.gloss: to decompose; to break down; to resolve; to explain

example.zh: 塑料袋需要几百年才能分解。
example.en: Plastic bags take hundreds of years to break down.

一如既往.gloss: as always; as before; just as in the past

example.zh: 我们会一如既往地为顾客提供优质服务。
example.en: As always, we will provide our customers with quality service.

example.zh: 这些奖学金专门用来帮助贫困学生。
example.en: These scholarships are specifically for helping poor students.

example.zh: 离开故乡二十年，他终于回来了。
example.en: After twenty years away from his hometown, he finally came back.

example.zh: 秦朝建立了中国第一个统一的中央政权。
example.en: The Qin dynasty established China's first unified central government.

example.zh: 他的爷爷曾经是一名海军司令。
example.en: His grandfather was once a naval commander.

反驳.gloss: to refute; to retort; to rebut

example.zh: 他的话很有道理，我一时不知道怎么反驳。
example.en: What he said made a lot of sense; for a moment I didn't know how to argue back.

example.zh: 阳光照在湖面上，反射出耀眼的光。
example.en: Sunlight falls on the lake and reflects a dazzling light.

内幕.indonesian: cerita di balik layar; informasi orang dalam

example.zh: 记者调查出了这件事的内幕。
example.en: The reporter uncovered the inside story of this affair.

锤.gloss: hammer; to hammer; weight (of a steelyard)

example.zh: 他用锤子把钉子钉进了墙里。
example.en: He used a hammer to drive the nail into the wall.

example.zh: 历史上很多科学家因为坚持真理而受到迫害。
example.en: In history, many scientists were persecuted for standing up for the truth.

诸位.gloss: everyone; ladies and gentlemen; all of you

example.zh: 感谢诸位今天来参加我们的活动。
example.en: Thank you all for coming to our event today.

example.zh: 他因为生病缺席了今天的会议。
example.en: He missed today's meeting because he was ill.

example.zh: 早饭我喜欢喝一碗热粥。
example.en: For breakfast I like a bowl of hot congee.

窜.gloss: to flee; to scurry; to dash; to alter (a text)
窜.indonesian: lari kocar-kacir; melesat; berlari cepat; mengubah (teks)

example.zh: 一只老鼠从厨房里窜了出来。
example.en: A mouse darted out of the kitchen.

描绘.gloss: to depict; to describe; to portray

example.zh: 这幅画描绘了江南水乡的美丽风景。
example.en: This painting depicts the beautiful scenery of the southern water towns.

example.zh: 这两条路是平行的，永远不会相交。
example.en: These two roads are parallel and will never meet.

干预.gloss: to intervene; to interfere; to meddle; intervention

example.zh: 父母不应该过多干预孩子的选择。
example.en: Parents shouldn't interfere too much in their children's choices.

example.zh: 演出结束后，演员们向观众鞠躬致谢。
example.en: After the show, the actors bowed to the audience in thanks.

融洽.gloss: harmonious; on friendly terms; in harmony

example.zh: 我们办公室的气氛很融洽。
example.en: The atmosphere in our office is very harmonious.

照样.gloss: as before; all the same; still; to follow a model
照样.indonesian: tetap; sama seperti biasa; tetap saja; mengikuti contoh

example.zh: 就算下雨，比赛照样进行。
example.en: Even if it rains, the match will go ahead as usual.

搂.gloss: to hug; to embrace; to hold in one's arms

example.zh: 妈妈把孩子搂在怀里。
example.en: The mother held the child in her arms.

example.zh: 按照惯例，新员工要先培训一个月。
example.en: As usual practice, new employees first train for a month.

较量.gloss: to compete; to have a contest; to pit one's strength against; contest

example.zh: 两支球队在决赛中展开了激烈的较量。
example.en: The two teams fought a fierce contest in the final.

熄灭.gloss: to go out (of a fire or light); to extinguish; to put out

example.zh: 晚上十一点，宿舍的灯全部熄灭了。
example.en: At eleven at night, all the lights in the dorm went out.

揉.gloss: to rub; to knead; to massage

example.zh: 他揉了揉眼睛，好像还没睡醒。
example.en: He rubbed his eyes as if he wasn't quite awake yet.

example.zh: 我们请了一位当地的向导带我们爬山。
example.en: We hired a local guide to take us up the mountain.

冻结.gloss: to freeze (assets, prices); to freeze (of water); frozen

example.zh: 他的银行账户被冻结了。
example.en: His bank account has been frozen.

做主.gloss: to decide; to make the decision; to take charge

example.zh: 这件事我可以做主，你就放心吧。
example.en: I can make the call on this, so don't worry.

鄙视.gloss: to despise; to look down on; to disdain

example.zh: 我们不应该鄙视任何一种诚实的劳动。
example.en: We shouldn't look down on any kind of honest work.

example.zh: 她请裁缝做了一件旗袍。
example.en: She had a tailor make her a qipao.

考察.gloss: to inspect; to investigate on the spot; to examine; field study

example.zh: 专家们到山区考察当地的教育情况。
example.en: Experts went to the mountain area to look into local education.

example.zh: 为了健康，她开始吃素食。
example.en: For her health, she started eating vegetarian food.

淹没.gloss: to submerge; to flood; to drown out

example.zh: 他的声音被热烈的掌声淹没了。
example.en: His voice was drowned out by the warm applause.

example.zh: 太阳不断地向四周放射出光和热。
example.en: The sun constantly radiates light and heat in all directions.

合伙.gloss: to form a partnership; to team up; partnership

example.zh: 他和朋友合伙开了一家咖啡馆。
example.en: He went into partnership with a friend and opened a café.

example.zh: 他这次是因为公务来上海的。
example.en: He came to Shanghai this time on official business.

example.zh: 月亮的光辉洒满了整个院子。
example.en: Moonlight filled the whole courtyard.

风光.gloss: scenery; view; glorious; grand (of an occasion)

example.zh: 这里的风光非常美丽，吸引了很多游客。
example.en: The scenery here is beautiful and attracts many tourists.

触犯.gloss: to violate; to offend; to infringe

example.zh: 他的行为已经触犯了公司的规定。
example.en: His behaviour has already broken company rules.

example.zh: 请把会议的要点记下来。
example.en: Please write down the key points of the meeting.

打官司.gloss: to go to court; to file a lawsuit; to litigate

example.zh: 为了这件小事打官司，太不值得了。
example.en: Going to court over such a small matter isn't worth it.

屑.gloss: crumbs; bits; scraps; to deign to
屑.indonesian: remah; serpihan; sudi (dalam 不屑 = tidak sudi)

example.zh: 吃完点心，桌子上全是饼干屑。
example.en: After the snack, the table was covered in biscuit crumbs.

伺候.gloss: to serve; to wait upon; to look after

example.zh: 奶奶生病了，妈妈每天在医院伺候她。
example.en: Grandma is ill, and Mum looks after her at the hospital every day.

款待.gloss: to entertain (guests); to treat cordially; hospitality

example.zh: 谢谢你们的热情款待。
example.en: Thank you for your warm hospitality.

example.zh: 他被评为全市的劳动模范。
example.en: He was named a model worker for the whole city.

构思.gloss: to conceive; to plan out (a piece of writing or art); conception

example.zh: 写作文之前，最好先构思一下。
example.en: Before writing an essay, it's best to plan it out first.

断绝.gloss: to break off; to sever; to cut off

example.zh: 大雪断绝了山里和外面的交通。
example.en: The heavy snow cut off transport between the mountains and the outside.

捎.gloss: to bring along; to take along (for someone); to pass on (a message)

example.zh: 你去超市的时候，帮我捎一瓶牛奶回来。
example.en: When you go to the supermarket, bring me back a bottle of milk.

不妨.gloss: might as well; there is no harm in
不妨.indonesian: tidak ada salahnya; sebaiknya; boleh saja

example.zh: 这个方法你不妨试一试。
example.en: There's no harm in giving this method a try.

注重.gloss: to pay attention to; to attach importance to; to emphasize

example.zh: 这所学校很注重培养学生的动手能力。
example.en: This school puts great emphasis on developing students' practical skills.

心血.indonesian: jerih payah; segenap tenaga dan pikiran

example.zh: 这本书凝聚了他十年的心血。
example.en: This book represents ten years of his painstaking effort.

example.zh: 他不愿意和人交流，在班上很孤立。
example.en: He doesn't like talking to people and is quite isolated in class.

失事.gloss: to have an accident (crash, wreck); to crash

example.zh: 这次飞机失事的原因还在调查中。
example.en: The cause of this plane crash is still under investigation.

example.zh: 病人疼得不停地呻吟。
example.en: The patient was in such pain that he kept groaning.

遵循.gloss: to follow; to abide by; to adhere to

example.zh: 做实验必须遵循科学的方法。
example.en: Experiments must follow scientific methods.

example.zh: 比赛的胜负并不重要，重要的是参与。
example.en: Winning or losing isn't important; what matters is taking part.

掠夺.gloss: to plunder; to rob; to loot

example.zh: 过度开发就是对自然资源的掠夺。
example.en: Overdevelopment amounts to plundering natural resources.

不堪.gloss: cannot bear; unbearable; utterly (after negative words)

example.zh: 连续工作了三天，他已经疲惫不堪。
example.en: After working three days straight, he was utterly exhausted.

麻木.indonesian: mati rasa; kebas; acuh tak acuh

example.zh: 在外面站了太久，我的脚都冻麻木了。
example.en: I stood outside so long that my feet went numb with cold.

精通.gloss: to be proficient in; to master; to have a good command of

example.zh: 她精通三种语言，是一名优秀的翻译。
example.en: She is fluent in three languages and is an excellent translator.

example.zh: 根据气象部门的预报，明天有大雨。
example.en: According to the weather service, there will be heavy rain tomorrow.

example.zh: 印度尼西亚曾经是荷兰的殖民地。
example.en: Indonesia was once a Dutch colony.

延伸.gloss: to extend; to stretch; to spread

example.zh: 这条公路一直延伸到海边。
example.en: This highway stretches all the way to the coast.

example.zh: 对学生来说，买这么贵的包太奢侈了。
example.en: For a student, buying such an expensive bag is too extravagant.

喘气.gloss: to pant; to gasp for breath; to take a breather

example.zh: 他一口气跑上了十楼，累得直喘气。
example.en: He ran up to the tenth floor in one go and was gasping for breath.

刊登.gloss: to publish (in a newspaper or magazine); to carry (a story)

example.zh: 她的文章刊登在今天的报纸上。
example.en: Her article appears in today's newspaper.

example.zh: 小溪里的水清得可以看见鱼。
example.en: The water in the stream is so clear you can see the fish.

example.zh: 我们要加快步伐，按时完成任务。
example.en: We need to pick up the pace to finish the task on time.

example.zh: 人生难免会遇到挫折，关键是不要放弃。
example.en: Setbacks are unavoidable in life; the key is not to give up.

example.zh: 妈妈做菜的手艺特别好。
example.en: Mum is a really skilled cook.

example.zh: 这个故事给了我很大的启示。
example.en: This story taught me a great lesson.

遍布.gloss: to be found everywhere; to spread all over

example.zh: 这家咖啡店的分店遍布全国。
example.en: This coffee chain has branches all over the country.

疏忽.gloss: to neglect; to overlook; negligence; oversight

example.zh: 由于一时疏忽，他把数字写错了。
example.en: Through a moment's carelessness, he wrote the number wrong.

example.zh: 他每天都关注股市的动态。
example.en: He follows developments in the stock market every day.

决策.gloss: to make a policy decision; decision; policy decision

example.zh: 这个决策关系到公司的未来。
example.en: This decision concerns the future of the company.

饶恕.gloss: to forgive; to pardon; to spare

example.zh: 请你饶恕我这一次吧。
example.en: Please forgive me just this once.

example.zh: 这是一家全国连锁的超市。
example.en: This is a nationwide supermarket chain.

example.zh: 孩子们在海边捡了很多贝壳。
example.en: The children picked up lots of shells at the beach.

example.zh: 这则广告里有很多虚假信息。
example.en: This advertisement contains a lot of false information.

藐视.gloss: to despise; to look down on; to treat with contempt

example.zh: 他藐视规则，最后吃了大亏。
example.en: He scorned the rules and paid dearly for it in the end.

施展.gloss: to put to good use; to display (one's talent); to give full play to

example.zh: 这份工作让他有机会施展自己的才能。
example.en: This job gives him a chance to put his talents to use.

坠.gloss: to fall; to drop; to hang down; pendant

example.zh: 一颗流星从天空坠落下来。
example.en: A shooting star fell from the sky.

example.zh: 他把身上的零钱都给了路边的乞丐。
example.en: He gave all his loose change to the beggar by the road.

衷心.indonesian: tulus; sepenuh hati; dari lubuk hati

example.zh: 衷心感谢大家对我的帮助。
example.en: My heartfelt thanks to everyone for your help.

example.zh: 这么重要的事情，不能草率决定。
example.en: Something this important can't be decided hastily.

example.zh: 时间紧迫，我们必须马上出发。
example.en: Time is short; we must set off right away.

沸腾.gloss: to boil; boiling; to seethe (with excitement)

example.zh: 听到这个好消息，全场沸腾了。
example.en: When they heard the good news, the whole place erupted.

想方设法.gloss: to try every means; to do everything possible
想方设法.indonesian: berusaha dengan segala cara; mencari segala jalan

example.zh: 他想方设法帮助有困难的同学。
example.en: He does everything he can to help classmates in difficulty.

冒充.gloss: to pretend to be; to pass oneself off as; to impersonate

example.zh: 有人冒充银行工作人员打电话骗钱。
example.en: Someone posed as a bank employee and phoned people to swindle money.

example.zh: 春节吃饺子是北方的习俗。
example.en: Eating dumplings at Spring Festival is a northern custom.

观光.gloss: to go sightseeing; to tour; sightseeing

example.zh: 每年都有很多外国游客来这里观光。
example.en: Every year many foreign tourists come here to sightsee.

example.zh: 两家公司因为合同问题发生了纠纷。
example.en: The two companies got into a dispute over the contract.

example.zh: 重要的文件一定要备份。
example.en: Important files must always be backed up.

example.zh: 学校周边有很多小吃店。
example.en: There are lots of snack shops around the school.

example.zh: 退休以后，她的生活过得很充实。
example.en: Since retiring, she has led a very full life.

储备.gloss: reserves; to store up; to stockpile

example.zh: 我们要为将来储备足够的知识。
example.en: We need to build up enough knowledge for the future.

example.zh: 他对下属很关心，大家都很尊敬他。
example.en: He cares about his staff, and everyone respects him.

example.zh: 中国的领土面积约为九百六十万平方公里。
example.en: China's territory covers about 9.6 million square kilometres.

example.zh: 我去领事馆办理了签证。
example.en: I went to the consulate to get my visa.

颁发.gloss: to award; to issue; to promulgate

example.zh: 校长为获奖学生颁发了证书。
example.en: The principal presented certificates to the winning students.

渗透.gloss: to permeate; to seep; to infiltrate; to penetrate

example.zh: 雨水渗透到了地下室。
example.en: Rainwater seeped into the basement.

宣扬.gloss: to publicize; to propagate; to make widely known

example.zh: 他做了好事，却从来不到处宣扬。
example.en: He does good deeds but never broadcasts them.

example.zh: 经理让我起草一份工作计划。
example.en: The manager asked me to draft a work plan.

起源.gloss: origin; to originate; to come from

example.zh: 你知道这个节日的起源吗？
example.en: Do you know the origin of this festival?

example.zh: 现在人人都离不开智能手机。
example.en: Nowadays nobody can do without a smartphone.

example.zh: 事情已经安排妥当，你放心吧。
example.en: Everything has been properly arranged, so don't worry.

向往.gloss: to yearn for; to long for; to look forward to

example.zh: 我一直很向往海边的生活。
example.en: I have always longed for life by the sea.

顾虑.gloss: misgiving; worry; scruple; to worry about

example.zh: 有什么顾虑你就直说吧。
example.en: If you have any concerns, just say so.

example.zh: 祝你们婚姻美满，白头到老。
example.en: Wishing you a happy marriage and a long life together.

example.zh: 这个研究项目缺少经费。
example.en: This research project is short of funding.

example.zh: 父母不要给孩子施加太大的压力。
example.en: Parents shouldn't put too much pressure on their children.

侥幸.gloss: lucky; by luck; by a fluke

example.zh: 这次考试他侥幸通过了。
example.en: He passed this exam by a stroke of luck.

繁殖.gloss: to breed; to reproduce; to propagate

example.zh: 春天是很多动物繁殖的季节。
example.en: Spring is the breeding season for many animals.

收缩.gloss: to shrink; to contract; to cut back

example.zh: 这件毛衣洗了以后收缩了不少。
example.en: This sweater shrank quite a bit after washing.

钦佩.gloss: to admire; to have great respect for

example.zh: 她的勇气让人十分钦佩。
example.en: Her courage is truly admirable.

大致.gloss: roughly; approximately; more or less; general

example.zh: 我大致了解了一下情况。
example.en: I've got a rough idea of the situation.

堵塞.gloss: to block; to stop up; to jam; blockage

example.zh: 下水道堵塞了，水流不下去。
example.en: The drain is blocked and the water won't go down.

example.zh: 这次会议取得了圆满成功。
example.en: The conference was a complete success.

example.zh: 人民币是中国的法定货币。
example.en: The renminbi is China's legal currency.

表态.gloss: to state one's position; to make one's position known

example.zh: 关于这件事，老板还没有表态。
example.en: The boss hasn't said where he stands on this yet.

example.zh: 水果中含有丰富的维生素。
example.en: Fruit is rich in vitamins.

沐浴.gloss: to bathe; to take a bath; to be bathed in (sunlight etc.)

example.zh: 我们沐浴在温暖的阳光下。
example.en: We basked in the warm sunshine.

树立.gloss: to set up; to establish; to build (an image, example)

example.zh: 父母应该给孩子树立好的榜样。
example.en: Parents should set a good example for their children.

反馈.gloss: feedback; to give feedback; to report back

example.zh: 我们非常重视顾客的反馈意见。
example.en: We value customer feedback very highly.

example.zh: 他给我留了一张便条，说晚上不回家吃饭。
example.en: He left me a note saying he wouldn't be home for dinner.

主导.gloss: leading; dominant; to dominate; to lead

example.zh: 服务业已经成为这座城市的主导产业。
example.en: The service sector has become the city's leading industry.

不得已.gloss: to have no choice; against one's will; reluctantly

example.zh: 我也是不得已才这么做的。
example.en: I only did it because I had no choice.

协商.gloss: to consult; to negotiate; to talk things over

example.zh: 这件事我们可以协商解决。
example.en: We can settle this matter through discussion.

冷却.gloss: to cool; to cool off; cooling

example.zh: 等汤冷却一下再放进冰箱。
example.en: Let the soup cool down before putting it in the fridge.

管辖.gloss: to have jurisdiction over; to administer; jurisdiction

example.zh: 这个地区归哪个派出所管辖？
example.en: Which police station has jurisdiction over this area?

example.zh: 奶奶的脸上布满了皱纹。
example.en: Grandma's face is covered in wrinkles.

example.zh: 皇帝召集大臣们商量国家大事。
example.en: The emperor summoned his ministers to discuss affairs of state.

example.zh: 我是间接从朋友那儿听说这件事的。
example.en: I heard about this secondhand from a friend.

起伏.gloss: to rise and fall; ups and downs; undulating

example.zh: 这几天他的情绪起伏很大。
example.en: His mood has been up and down a lot these past few days.

笼罩.gloss: to envelop; to shroud; to hang over

example.zh: 整个城市都笼罩在大雾之中。
example.en: The whole city is shrouded in thick fog.

派遣.gloss: to send; to dispatch (on a mission)

example.zh: 公司派遣他到国外工作两年。
example.en: The company sent him abroad to work for two years.

扩张.gloss: to expand; to extend; to dilate; expansion

example.zh: 这家公司近年来扩张得很快。
example.en: This company has expanded rapidly in recent years.

example.zh: 喜马拉雅山脉是世界上最高的山脉。
example.en: The Himalayas are the highest mountain range in the world.

example.zh: 他住在一个很偏僻的小山村里。
example.en: He lives in a very remote little mountain village.

调节.gloss: to adjust; to regulate; to moderate

example.zh: 运动可以帮助调节心情。
example.en: Exercise can help regulate your mood.

example.zh: 主持人拿起话筒，向大家问好。
example.en: The host picked up the microphone and greeted everyone.

攒.gloss: to save up; to accumulate; to collect

example.zh: 他攒了两年的钱，终于买了一台电脑。
example.en: He saved for two years and finally bought a computer.

撇.gloss: to cast aside; to throw; to curl (one's lip); left-falling stroke
撇.indonesian: mengesampingkan; melempar; mencibir; goresan miring ke kiri

example.zh: 她撇了撇嘴，好像不太高兴。
example.en: She curled her lip, looking rather unhappy.

掰.gloss: to break off with the hands; to snap; to pull apart

example.zh: 他把面包掰成两半，分给了我一半。
example.en: He broke the bread in two and gave me half.

example.zh: 这种香水的味道很持久。
example.en: The scent of this perfume lasts a long time.

example.zh: 教师是一个崇高的职业。
example.en: Teaching is a noble profession.

example.zh: 这座桥非常坚固，已经用了一百年了。
example.en: This bridge is very sturdy; it has been in use for a hundred years.

务必.gloss: must; be sure to; without fail

example.zh: 明天的会议请大家务必准时参加。
example.en: Everyone must be on time for tomorrow's meeting.

example.zh: 这本书引起了很多读者的共鸣。
example.en: This book struck a chord with many readers.

example.zh: 他把一部分钱用来购买国债券。
example.en: He used part of his money to buy government bonds.

众所周知.gloss: as everyone knows; as is well known
众所周知.indonesian: seperti diketahui semua orang; sudah umum diketahui

example.zh: 众所周知，吸烟对身体有害。
example.en: As everyone knows, smoking is bad for your health.

预兆.gloss: omen; sign; to foreshadow; to presage

example.zh: 燕子低飞是下雨的预兆。
example.en: Swallows flying low is a sign of rain.

example.zh: 今年工作的重心是开发新产品。
example.en: This year our work will focus on developing new products.

调动.gloss: to transfer; to move; to mobilize; to arouse (enthusiasm)

example.zh: 老师想办法调动学生学习的积极性。
example.en: The teacher tries to motivate the students to learn.

example.zh: 她获得了“优秀员工”的称号。
example.en: She was given the title of Outstanding Employee.

example.zh: 方圆几十里只有这一家医院。
example.en: This is the only hospital for dozens of li around.

example.zh: 选择专业是件大事，一定要慎重。
example.en: Choosing a major is a big decision; you must be careful.

example.zh: 我做的这点事微不足道，不用谢。
example.en: What I did was nothing; no need to thank me.

埋怨.gloss: to complain; to grumble; to blame

example.zh: 出了问题不要只会埋怨别人。
example.en: When something goes wrong, don't just blame others.

选拔.gloss: to select; to choose (the best); selection

example.zh: 学校正在选拔参加比赛的学生。
example.en: The school is selecting students to take part in the competition.

追究.gloss: to look into; to investigate; to hold accountable

example.zh: 这次是小错误，就不追究你的责任了。
example.en: It's only a small mistake this time, so we won't hold you responsible.

筹备.gloss: to prepare; to make preparations; to arrange

example.zh: 我们正在筹备下个月的音乐节。
example.en: We are preparing for next month's music festival.

example.zh: 他大学学的是国防科技专业。
example.en: At university he majored in defence technology.

example.zh: 填表时请写上配偶的姓名。
example.en: When filling in the form, please write your spouse's name.

example.zh: 越来越多的年轻人加入了志愿者的行列。
example.en: More and more young people are joining the ranks of volunteers.

联想.gloss: to associate; to connect in the mind; association

example.zh: 看到这张照片，我联想到了小时候。
example.en: Seeing this photo reminded me of my childhood.

示威.gloss: to demonstrate; to stage a protest; to put on a show of strength

example.zh: 那只猫对着小狗大叫，好像在示威。
example.en: The cat yowled at the puppy as if putting on a show of strength.

example.zh: 湖面上漂浮着几片树叶。
example.en: A few leaves are floating on the surface of the lake.

抵制.gloss: to resist; to boycott; to refuse

example.zh: 我们要自觉抵制不健康的网络内容。
example.en: We should consciously resist unhealthy online content.

example.zh: 我家就住在这条小巷的尽头。
example.en: My home is at the end of this little alley.

example.zh: 这个行业的发展前景非常好。
example.en: This industry has excellent prospects.

闪烁.gloss: to twinkle; to flicker; to glimmer; evasive

example.zh: 夜空中闪烁着无数颗星星。
example.en: Countless stars twinkle in the night sky.

计较.gloss: to fuss about; to haggle over; to argue; to dispute

example.zh: 他是个大方的人，从不计较小事。
example.en: He's a generous person and never fusses over small things.

example.zh: 这只猴子动作非常敏捷。
example.en: This monkey moves very nimbly.

恨不得.gloss: to be itching to; to wish one could; to be dying to
恨不得.indonesian: ingin sekali; kalau bisa; sangat ingin

example.zh: 放假了，我恨不得马上飞回家。
example.en: The holidays are here, and I wish I could fly home right now.

废除.gloss: to abolish; to annul; to repeal

example.zh: 这条不合理的规定终于被废除了。
example.en: This unreasonable rule has finally been abolished.

example.zh: 夜深了，街上一片寂静。
example.en: It was late at night, and the street was completely silent.

四肢.gloss: the four limbs; arms and legs
四肢.indonesian: keempat anggota badan; tangan dan kaki

example.zh: 做运动前要先活动一下四肢。
example.en: Before exercising, loosen up your arms and legs.

example.zh: 体育馆里有各种健身器材。
example.en: The gym has all kinds of fitness equipment.

example.zh: 狗的嗅觉比人灵敏得多。
example.en: A dog's sense of smell is far keener than a human's.

example.zh: 违反比赛规则的球员受到了制裁。
example.en: The players who broke the rules of the competition were penalized.

盛.gloss: to fill (a bowl); to ladle out; flourishing; grand

example.zh: 妈妈给我盛了一碗米饭。
example.en: Mum served me a bowl of rice.

example.zh: 为了庆祝春节，妈妈做了一桌丰盛的饭菜。
example.en: To celebrate Spring Festival, Mum made a lavish spread of dishes.

example.zh: 自来水要过滤以后再喝。
example.en: Tap water should be filtered before drinking.

example.zh: 站在大山面前，人显得多么渺小。
example.en: Standing before a great mountain, a person seems so tiny.

腐蚀.gloss: to corrode; to erode; to corrupt

example.zh: 海水会腐蚀船上的金属。
example.en: Seawater corrodes the metal on ships.

example.zh: 他胡乱吃了几口饭就出门了。
example.en: He gulped down a few mouthfuls and went out.

example.zh: 你有什么特长？会唱歌还是会画画？
example.en: What are you good at? Singing or painting?

振奋.gloss: to inspire; to rouse; to stimulate; inspired

example.zh: 这个好消息让大家精神振奋。
example.en: This good news lifted everyone's spirits.

加工.gloss: to process; to machine; to polish (work); processing

example.zh: 这些水果经过加工，做成了果汁。
example.en: This fruit was processed and made into juice.

example.zh: 人在紧张的时候，身体会分泌更多汗水。
example.en: When people are nervous, their bodies secrete more sweat.

example.zh: 上下班高峰的时候，地铁里人特别多。
example.en: The subway is especially crowded during rush hour.

example.zh: 收入提高了，生活水平也相应地提高了。
example.en: Incomes have risen, and living standards have risen accordingly.

example.zh: 他的腿扭伤了，走路一瘸一拐的。
example.en: He sprained his leg and is walking with a limp.

流露.gloss: to reveal (feelings); to show; to betray (unintentionally)

example.zh: 她的眼睛里流露出一丝失望。
example.en: A hint of disappointment showed in her eyes.

启程.gloss: to set out; to start a journey

example.zh: 代表团明天上午启程回国。
example.en: The delegation sets off for home tomorrow morning.

倾斜.gloss: to tilt; to slant; to incline; to favour (in policy)

example.zh: 这座塔已经倾斜了好几百年。
example.en: This tower has been leaning for several hundred years.

借助.gloss: to draw support from; with the help of; by means of

example.zh: 借助字典，他终于读懂了这篇文章。
example.en: With the help of a dictionary, he finally understood the article.

example.zh: 如果遗失了身份证，要马上去补办。
example.en: If you lose your ID card, get a replacement right away.

混淆.gloss: to confuse; to mix up; to blur

example.zh: 这两个词的意思很容易混淆。
example.en: The meanings of these two words are easy to mix up.

example.zh: 他身上有一种不怕困难的英雄气概。
example.en: He has a heroic spirit that isn't afraid of difficulties.

example.zh: 这笔钱作为机动资金，以备急用。
example.en: This money is kept as a flexible fund for emergencies.

承办.gloss: to undertake; to host (an event); to take on

example.zh: 这次比赛由我们学校承办。
example.en: This competition is being hosted by our school.

冤枉.gloss: to wrong; to treat unjustly; wronged; not worthwhile
冤枉.indonesian: menuduh secara salah; memperlakukan tidak adil; dirugikan; sia-sia

example.zh: 这件事不是我做的，你冤枉我了。
example.en: I didn't do this; you've wronged me.

倒闭.gloss: to go bankrupt; to close down

example.zh: 由于经营不善，这家工厂倒闭了。
example.en: Due to poor management, the factory closed down.

example.zh: 他的感人事迹被写进了课本。
example.en: His moving deeds were written into the textbook.

逼迫.gloss: to force; to compel; to coerce

example.zh: 父母不应该逼迫孩子学自己不喜欢的东西。
example.en: Parents shouldn't force children to learn things they don't like.

example.zh: 去别人家做客要注意礼节。
example.en: When visiting someone's home, mind your manners.

example.zh: 这些年，村民们的生活越来越富裕了。
example.en: In recent years, the villagers have become more and more prosperous.

example.zh: 图书馆里有各种各样的书籍。
example.en: The library has all kinds of books.

之际.gloss: at the time of; on the occasion of; during

example.zh: 在新年到来之际，祝大家身体健康。
example.en: As the New Year arrives, I wish everyone good health.

表决.gloss: to vote; to decide by vote; vote
表决.indonesian: memungut suara; memutuskan dengan voting; pemungutan suara

example.zh: 这个方案需要全体成员表决通过。
example.en: This plan needs to be passed by a vote of all members.

example.zh: 这个包是用真皮革做的。
example.en: This bag is made of genuine leather.

example.zh: 这本书的内容很枯燥，我看不下去。
example.en: This book is so dull that I can't keep reading it.

惦记.gloss: to keep thinking about; to worry about; to remember with concern

example.zh: 我一切都好，你不用惦记我。
example.en: I'm doing fine; you don't need to worry about me.

example.zh: 华北平原是中国重要的粮食产区。
example.en: The North China Plain is an important grain-producing region of China.

example.zh: 我们的老师很和蔼，从来不发脾气。
example.en: Our teacher is very kind and never loses her temper.

example.zh: 我的记性越来越差了，刚说的话就忘了。
example.en: My memory is getting worse; I forget what I've just said.

衰老.gloss: to age; to grow old; ageing; senile

example.zh: 适当的运动可以延缓衰老。
example.en: The right amount of exercise can slow down ageing.

example.zh: 看病应该去正规的医院。
example.en: You should see a doctor at a proper, licensed hospital.

example.zh: 这家店卖的水果品种很多。
example.en: This shop sells many varieties of fruit.

example.zh: 学校在网上发布了放假公告。
example.en: The school posted a holiday notice online.

转达.gloss: to pass on; to convey; to relay

example.zh: 请你转达我对你父母的问候。
example.en: Please pass on my regards to your parents.

example.zh: 把这些药片磨成粉末再喝。
example.en: Grind these tablets into powder before taking them.

掀起.gloss: to lift; to raise; to set off (a wave or trend)

example.zh: 这部电视剧在年轻人中掀起了学汉语的热潮。
example.en: This TV series set off a craze for learning Chinese among young people.

平面.indonesian: bidang datar; permukaan rata; dua dimensi; grafis (desain)

example.zh: 她在一家广告公司做平面设计。
example.en: She does graphic design at an advertising agency.

嚷.gloss: to shout; to yell; to make a fuss

example.zh: 别嚷了，孩子正在睡觉呢。
example.en: Stop shouting; the baby is sleeping.

贬低.gloss: to belittle; to disparage; to play down

example.zh: 不要为了抬高自己而贬低别人。
example.en: Don't put others down to make yourself look better.

空洞.gloss: empty; hollow; devoid of content; cavity

example.zh: 这篇文章内容空洞，没有说服力。
example.en: This article is empty of substance and unconvincing.

种植.gloss: to plant; to grow; to cultivate

example.zh: 这里的农民主要种植水稻。
example.en: The farmers here mainly grow rice.

example.zh: 台风带来了猛烈的大风和暴雨。
example.en: The typhoon brought fierce winds and heavy rain.

爱戴.gloss: to love and respect; to esteem; love and esteem

example.zh: 这位老校长深受学生们的爱戴。
example.en: This old headmaster is deeply loved and respected by the students.

example.zh: 他是这个家庭的经济支柱。
example.en: He is the family's main breadwinner.

探讨.gloss: to explore; to discuss; to inquire into

example.zh: 我们今天来探讨一下学习汉语的好方法。
example.en: Today let's discuss good ways to learn Chinese.

心态.indonesian: sikap mental; pola pikir; kondisi batin

example.zh: 考试的时候，保持良好的心态很重要。
example.en: During exams, keeping a positive state of mind is important.

关怀.gloss: to care for; to show concern for; care; concern

example.zh: 感谢老师对我们的关怀和帮助。
example.en: Thank you, teacher, for your care and help.

辫子.gloss: plait; braid; pigtail; mistake someone can exploit
辫子.indonesian: kepang; kuncir; kelemahan (yang bisa dimanfaatkan orang)

example.zh: 小女孩梳着两条长长的辫子。
example.en: The little girl wears her hair in two long braids.

example.zh: 他挺起胸膛，自信地走上了舞台。
example.en: He puffed out his chest and walked confidently onto the stage.

example.zh: 爷爷留着长长的白胡须。
example.en: Grandpa has a long white beard.

国务院.gloss: State Council (of China); State Department (of the US)

example.zh: 国务院是中国最高的国家行政机关。
example.en: The State Council is China's highest administrative body.

example.zh: 这是全国最繁忙的机场之一。
example.en: This is one of the busiest airports in the country.

民间.gloss: folk; popular; among the people; non-governmental
民间.indonesian: rakyat; tradisional (cerita rakyat dll.); di kalangan rakyat; swasta

example.zh: 这是一个流传很广的民间故事。
example.en: This is a widely told folk tale.

无动于衷.indonesian: tidak tergerak; acuh tak acuh; tidak peduli

example.zh: 大家都很着急，他却无动于衷。
example.en: Everyone was anxious, but he remained completely unmoved.

example.zh: 新房子又宽敞又明亮。
example.en: The new house is spacious and bright.

example.zh: 这个商标已经注册了。
example.en: This trademark has already been registered.

受罪.gloss: to suffer; to have a hard time; to endure hardship

example.zh: 这么热的天还要排队，真是受罪。
example.en: Having to queue on such a hot day is real torture.

体谅.gloss: to show understanding; to make allowances for; to be considerate

example.zh: 我们要体谅父母工作的辛苦。
example.en: We should understand how hard our parents work.

风味.indonesian: cita rasa khas; rasa daerah; gaya

example.zh: 这家餐厅的菜很有地方风味。
example.en: The dishes at this restaurant have a real local flavour.

example.zh: 从学生到职员，需要一个过渡阶段。
example.en: Going from student to employee takes a period of transition.

example.zh: 他对这个问题有独到的见解。
example.en: He has original insights into this problem.

example.zh: 明天要面试，我得把衬衫熨一下。
example.en: I have an interview tomorrow, so I need to iron my shirt.

濒临.gloss: to be on the verge of; to be close to; to border on

example.zh: 这种动物已经濒临灭绝。
example.en: This animal is already on the verge of extinction.

example.zh: 我们要找到问题的根源。
example.en: We need to find the root of the problem.

定期.gloss: regularly; at regular intervals; fixed-term; periodical

example.zh: 你应该定期去医院检查身体。
example.en: You should go to the hospital for regular check-ups.

凑合.gloss: to make do; to get by; passable; to gather together

example.zh: 今天没时间做饭，我们就凑合着吃点面条吧。
example.en: There's no time to cook today, so let's make do with some noodles.

健全.gloss: sound; perfect; complete; to improve (a system)

example.zh: 公司需要建立健全的管理制度。
example.en: The company needs to establish a sound management system.

example.zh: 朋友吵架的时候，我选择保持中立。
example.en: When my friends argue, I choose to stay neutral.

谅解.gloss: to understand; to make allowances; to forgive; understanding

example.zh: 给您带来不便，请您谅解。
example.en: We apologise for any inconvenience and ask for your understanding.

自主.gloss: independent; to decide for oneself; autonomous

example.zh: 孩子长大了，应该学会自主做决定。
example.en: As children grow up, they should learn to make their own decisions.

example.zh: 她急切地想知道考试的结果。
example.en: She was anxious to know her exam results.

开展.gloss: to carry out; to launch; to develop; to unfold

example.zh: 学校开展了丰富多彩的课外活动。
example.en: The school runs a wide variety of extracurricular activities.

台风.indonesian: topan; angin taifun; penampilan di panggung

example.zh: 台风明天就要到了，大家注意安全。
example.en: The typhoon arrives tomorrow; everyone please stay safe.

畅销.gloss: to sell well; best-selling; in great demand

example.zh: 这本小说一出版就十分畅销。
example.en: This novel sold extremely well as soon as it came out.

犹如.gloss: just like; as if; similar to

example.zh: 这里的风景犹如一幅美丽的画。
example.en: The scenery here is like a beautiful painting.

example.zh: 这件衣服的款式很新颖。
example.en: This garment has a very fresh design.

断定.gloss: to conclude; to determine; to judge

example.zh: 现在还不能断定是谁的错。
example.en: We can't yet say for certain whose fault it is.

example.zh: 这位老师傅一共带过二十多个徒弟。
example.en: This old master has trained more than twenty apprentices.

大肆.gloss: wantonly; without restraint; on a large scale

example.zh: 有些商家大肆宣传，其实产品质量很一般。
example.en: Some sellers advertise like crazy, but their products are actually mediocre.

不时.gloss: from time to time; frequently; at any time

example.zh: 他一边听课，一边不时地记笔记。
example.en: He listened to the lecture, taking notes every now and then.

example.zh: 墙上挂着一幅爷爷的肖像。
example.en: A portrait of Grandpa hangs on the wall.
